text:
sam: Heads-up 1: I'm sketching a new navigation topology to improve left-rail cohesion. Idea: introduce 'cohesion groups' that visually cluster related items (Models, Datasets, Evaluations) but keep explicit crumb anchors above the canvas. Mock: https://staging.redwood/design/nav-topology-cohesion.png

anya: Curious. I like the visual grouping, but must keep direct deep links stable. If we change visual grouping, permalinks should still be `/console/w/:org/models/:id`. Don't want redirects for every in-app nav.

liam: Agree. Implementation approach: canonical routes stay the same. Add client-side aliases like `/console/w/:org/cohesion/:group/:id` that map to canonical routes without a network redirect. For old public shortlinks we can add server 301s for bookmarks. Example redirect rules we can land on:```js
{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', code: 301 }
{ from: '/m/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', code: 302 }
```We should also persist UI state in querystring for reproducible deep links (e.g., `?panel=metrics&split=true`).

rachel: Accessibility checklist: cohesion group toggle must be keyboard operable and expose `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`. Use an `aria-live="polite"` message for user-triggered toggles only ("Models group expanded"). When landing via permalink and we auto-reveal the item, do NOT move focus; instead expose `aria-current="page"` on the breadcrumb.

sam: Copy naming options gathered: 'Cohesion', 'Workspace groups', 'Collections', 'Clusters'. My lean: 'Collections' — short and people understand it. But we can A/B test label variants and measure nav click-through vs search fallback.

anya: Banner idea for rollout: small, dismissible: "Models & related items now grouped under Collections  Show me". CTAs: "Show me" / "Take tour". Track CTA CTR and whether people then use search.

liam: Deep-link example we want to support: `/console/w/acme/models/123?split=1&panel=metrics#throughput`. Note: hash anchors should be reserved for scroll targets only; keep UI state in querystring. Middleware must preserve both during any rewrite.

rachel: Keyboard specifics: group header should be a button, toggle with Enter/Space, arrow keys move through children, ESC collapses. Provide a skiplink to main content. For live-region text keep it minimal and debounce rapid toggles to avoid spamming screen readers.

sam: Action items: @liam add client alias mapping and server redirect table for legacy shortlinks; ensure query/hash preservation and emit `route:hydrated` event so we run anchor scroll after layout. @anya craft banner copy + A/B variants and design tour microflow. @rachel add a11y acceptance criteria and keyboard testcases.

nav-bot: preview: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/nav-topology-collections (build 6021) :rocket:

liam: No infra blockers. I'll PR alias mapping and middleware for preserving query/hash this afternoon.

anya: I'll upload banner art and the two label variants for A/B today. Short copy suggestion: "Models and related items are now in Collections  Show" / "Tour".

rachel: I'll add screen reader smoke test steps (NVDA/VoiceOver) and ensure no programmatic focus steal on permalink loads.

sam: Thanks team  aiming for alpha on staging next week. Ping me if you hit anything blocking. :thumbsup:
